trang_bt.mn.tra_loi: People born in {nam} ({tc}, the year of the {con}) have the Na Yin element {ten} ({han}), which belongs to {hanh}. Its image: {ht}. If you were born before Lunar New Year ({tet}), you count as a {tc_t} ({con_t}) person, Na Yin {ten_t}.
trang_bt.mn.sinh_ta: {a} feeds {b}: the element that supports you.
trang_bt.mn.khac_ta: {a} controls {b}: the element that puts pressure on you.

trang_bt.mn.mau_nghe: Colours and kinds of work by element (folk use)
trang_bt.mn.mau_nghe_doan: This is a folk use of the Five Elements, for choosing colours and everyday things. It does not replace your own taste or real conditions. House direction is not chosen by Na Yin; see the Kua section below.
trang_bt.mn.mau_khac: Use {h} colours in moderation (it controls your element): {mau}.
trang_bt.mn.hop_xung: Signs that match or clash with the {chi}
trang_bt.mn.hop_xung_doan: Based on the branch of your birth year. This is a folk view of easy and difficult temperaments, not a basis for choosing a partner or a business partner.
trang_bt.mn.cung_phi: Kua number and best directions for people born in {nam}
trang_bt.mn.cung_phi_doan: Eight Mansions feng shui (for house, bed and desk direction) uses the Kua from your birth year and sex, not the Na Yin. So a man and a woman born in the same year can suit very different directions.
trang_bt.mn.cung_nam: Men born in {nam}: Kua {so} ({quai}, {nhom}), best direction {huong}; four good directions: {bon}.
trang_bt.mn.cung_nu: Women born in {nam}: Kua {so} ({quai}, {nhom}), best direction {huong}; four good directions: {bon}.
trang_bt.mn.dau_nam: Born early in {nam}: which year do you count?
trang_bt.mn.dau_nam_doan: The lunar year {tc} starts at Lunar New Year ({tet}, Vietnamese lunar calendar). That is the usual line for age and Na Yin. BaZi and Eight Mansions use Start of Spring ({lx}) instead. If you were born before the line, you belong to the {tc_t} year ({nam_t}), Na Yin {ten_t}.
trang_bt.mn.chu_y: Years to note for {tc} ({con}) people born in {nam}
trang_bt.mn.chu_y_doan: These dates follow Vietnamese folk custom and count from the lunar birth year (nominal age = current year − birth year + 1). Use them only as a reference when timing big steps; many families go ahead as normal, or 'borrow' a relative's age.
trang_bt.mn.h1: Born in {nam}: what is my element?
trang_bt.mn.d1: Na Yin {ten}, in the {hanh} element ({tc} year, the {con}).
trang_bt.mn.d2: In folk use: the colours of {a}, and of {b} (which supports your element). Use {c} colours in moderation.
trang_bt.mn.d3: Three Harmonies: {th}. Six Harmonies: {lh}. Six Clashes: {lx}. This is folk belief, for reference only.
trang_bt.mn.d4: Before Lunar New Year ({tet}) you belong to the {tc_t} year, Na Yin {ten_t}. From Lunar New Year on, it is {ten}.
trang_bt.mn.h5: Which house direction suits people born in {nam}?
trang_bt.mn.d5: In Eight Mansions, house direction follows the Kua, not the Na Yin {ten}. Men born in {nam} have Kua {so_n} ({qn}), best direction {hn}; women born in {nam} have Kua {so_u} ({qu}), best direction {hu}.
trang_bt.mn.h6: How is Na Yin {ten} different from the Kua?
trang_bt.mn.d6: The Na Yin ({ten}) is the same for men and women. The Kua (men Kua {so_n}, {qn}; women Kua {so_u}, {qu}) is used to choose house direction.

trang_bt.mn.lk_nu: Best directions for a woman born in {nam} (Kua {so}, {quai})
trang_bt.mn.mo_ta: Born in {nam} ({tc}, {con}): Na Yin {ten}, {hanh} element. Meaning, colours, matching signs and Kua for men and women.
